report.explanation: Alert shows four checkout observations, all HTTP 200, with one 344ms outlier and three at 62-78ms. Traces show all spans 200/ok with no error status; metrics show zero 502s and no dependency-operation failures; logs are all INFO. No evidence establishes any taxonomy cause (no 500s, no pool exhaustion, no redis timeout, no memory leak, no deployment). Insufficient to bound a root cause; hand off.
missing_evidence: Latency baseline/SLO for /v1/checkout to judge whether 344ms is anomalous
Sustained latency time series beyond the 20s window to confirm or exclude a trend
Dependency-level latency/error metrics for order, inventory, payment, postgres, redis
Any error or timeout logs correlated with the slow request
